cinematic_hero.title: Britain is reconnecting industry to a network that can no longer promise to keep the lights on.
cinematic_hero.lede: Non-firm connections clear the queue fastest. The market prices damage; the loss is interruption. NFRI scores exposure against preparedness — and the margin between them.

welcome_modal.title: Non-Firm Power Risk Index
welcome_modal.subtitle: UK insurance market · interruptible grid power
welcome_modal.body: Two scored axes — Exposure and Preparedness — reduce to a Margin of Safety. Every rating traces to a register, filing, or cited source.
welcome_modal.footnote: Scores below the publication gate are marked PROVISIONAL.
